I am currently a Ph.D. student in **Electrical and Computer Engineering** at the **University of Pittsburgh**, supervised by [Prof. Liang Zhan](https://www.engineering.pitt.edu/people/faculty/liang-zhan/). I also work closely with [Prof. Chenghua Lin](https://chenghua-lin.github.io/) from the University of Manchester.

My research primarily focuses on **Natural Language Processing (NLP)** and **Multi-modal AI**, dedicated to building efficient, safe, and trustworthy AI systems for high-stakes domains.

### 🔬 Research Interests

* **RL for LLMs**: Exploring advanced alignment algorithms such as **PPO, DPO, and GRPO**, specifically focusing on solving mode collapse and improving stability in complex reasoning tasks.
* **AI for Mental Health**: Building empathetic agents for **Psychotherapy**, focusing on long-term dialogue memory, crisis intervention protocols, and safety constraints.
* **Medical Multi-modal AI**:
    * **Radiology Report Generation**: Aligning visual findings with textual diagnosis using Reinforcement Learning (RL) and creating lay-language summarization datasets.
    * **Neuroimaging Analysis**: Investigating brain structural networks and interpretable spatio-temporal embeddings for Alzheimer's Disease progression.
* **Dialogue Evaluation**: Developing robust evaluation metrics and frameworks (combining Small and Large Language Models) to assess open-domain dialogue quality in latent spaces.

### 🔥 News

* **[2026.02]** Working on "Aligning Findings with Diagnosis," a self-consistent RL framework for trustworthy radiology reporting.
* **[2025.12]** Working on "**R-GenIMA**," a novel framework integrating Neuroimaging and Genetics with interpretable Multi-modal AI for Alzheimer’s Disease progression.
* **[2025.11]** One paper accepted to **EMNLP 2025** regarding structured information in dialogue evaluation.
* **[2025.06]** Our dataset "X-ray Made Simple" was selected as the **Official Dataset** for the Shared Task at the **BioNLP Workshop, ACL 2025**.
* **[2025.01]** Published a journal paper in **Alzheimer's & Dementia** on brain structural network alterations.
* **[2024.05]** One paper (SLIDE) accepted to **ACL 2024**.
* **[2023.07]** One paper accepted to **ACL 2023 (Main Oral)**.
